evidence.title: heroicons-animated | Free Animated Heroicons for React

name: heroicons-animated
summary: Open-source set of 316 animated Heroicons for React, built with Motion and installable icon by icon with the shadcn CLI.
description: Collection of 316 Heroicons rebuilt as animated React components with the Motion library. Each icon has its own page and can be added one at a time with a shadcn CLI command or through the @heroicons-animated/react package for React 18/19; MIT licensed.
contains: built on Heroicons with the Motion animation engine
